_e136: GREW ONCE, 2026-08-10, and only because the SCANNER was wrong — E-136. Reachability was computed over RAW source, so merely NAMING a script in a comment marked it covered. This file's own gate documented these very scripts as examples of dangerous orphans, and that sentence is what marked them reachable. They were never run; they were miscounted. Comments are stripped now, so the 10 names added here are a CORRECTION of the 2026-07-30 baseline, not new debt. The shrink-only rule stands from this list forward.
_e250: 2026-08-29 — THE LIST GREW, AND ONLY AS A CORRECTION, exactly as _e136 did. `orphan-scripts.mjs` walked the TOP LEVEL of scripts/ only, while printing 'every file in scripts/ must be run, or declared unrun'. It was not: 113 code files live in subdirectories and none was ever looked at. Making the walk recursive revealed 47 of them that nothing runs and nothing admitted — including scripts/design-gate/, the entire measurement rig of the live DESIGN-GATE-2026-08-28 programme (grep -c design-gate package.json returned 0). Those five are now ADOPTED as qa:dg-*; the rest are declared here with reasons. Entries for nested files are paths relative to scripts/; top-level entries stay bare basenames, so the original 192 are untouched. The rule is unchanged: this list may only shrink from here.
